recommendations.headline: Customer satisfaction, not price, is the real conversion driver: satisfied calls close at 74% vs 13% for neutral and 4% for dissatisfied, yet 55% of calls (401/723) remain merely 'neutral' and 53% end in callback with no firm next step.
behaviour: 53% of calls (382/723) end in 'callback' and only 20% (148/723) convert to an order, showing heavy stalling behaviour.

Price-shopping is the single most common behaviour (134 calls) alongside comparing_quotes (68) and competitor_cheaper objections, but price is actually discussed in only 32% of calls (229/723; 494 'not_discussed').
Stock availability is the top customer need (134) and top objection (116), with the lowest win rate among major objections (18%).
Repeat_buyer (72) and bulk_buyer (64) behaviours show a strong base of recurring/large customers worth retaining proactively.
Needs_technical_help (81) and technical_advice need (44) indicate many customers still require product/spec guidance before deciding.
satisfaction: Win rate tracks satisfaction almost perfectly: 74% for satisfied (192 calls), 13% for neutral (401 calls), 4% for dissatisfied (80 calls) - satisfaction is the strongest predictor of a sale.
Only 27% of calls (192/723) are rated satisfied while 11% (80) are dissatisfied, leaving a large 'neutral' middle (55%, 401 calls) that is not being converted.

Price_high is the top objection (127 calls) but only 30 calls (4%) explicitly say price is 'too high' and 46 (6%) 'accept' it outright - most price conversations are left unresolved (133 negotiating, 494 not even discussed), suggesting reps under-address pricing rather than losing on price itself.
Rep execution gaps directly hurt satisfaction: slow_or_unclear_answer (130 calls) and no_follow_up_fixed (114) are the top missed actions, both of which erode trust before price is even discussed.

conversion.title: Lock every callback to a fixed date/time
conversion.evidence: 382 of 723 calls (53%) end as 'callback' with no order, and no_follow_up_fixed is the #2 missed action (114 calls).
conversion.action: Reps must set and log a specific follow-up date/time on every call and managers must audit that the callback actually happens within that window.

conversion.title: Fix slow/unclear answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the single most frequent rep gap (130 calls) and satisfied calls convert at 74% vs 13% for neutral.
conversion.action: Equip reps with a quick-reference rate/stock sheet and script for common queries so answers are given within the same call, not 'will check and call back'.

conversion.title: Send quotes/proforma invoices same-day
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent flagged in 88 calls; many stalled summaries show customers waiting on quotations.
conversion.action: Create a standard quote/PI template reps can fill and send via WhatsApp/email within an hour of the call, with manager tracking turnaround time.

conversion.title: Always offer an alternative when stock is short
conversion.evidence: Stock_availability is the top objection (116 calls) with the lowest win rate (18%) and didnt_offer_alternative appears in 60 calls.
conversion.action: Train reps to immediately propose a substitute size/grade/partial quantity or off-cut stock instead of just saying 'not available'.

conversion.title: Explicitly ask for the order
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order appears in 51 calls despite 62 'interested' outcomes that didn't convert.
conversion.action: Add a mandatory closing step/script line ('Shall I book this quantity for you today?') before ending any call where interest is shown.

conversion.title: Build a competitor rebuttal script
conversion.evidence: competitor_cheaper has the worst win rate of any objection (5%, 22 calls).
conversion.action: Arm reps with value talking points (quality, test certificates, cutting service, delivery reliability) to use whenever a competitor's price is mentioned, rather than only matching or refusing price.

conversion.title: Prioritise dealer and fabricator segments, qualify 'unknown' leads fast
conversion.evidence: Dealer (34%) and fabricator (35%) segments win far more than unknown (19%) and industrial (18%) segments.
conversion.action: Reps should ask segment/role-identifying questions early in unknown-caller conversations and route high-potential dealer/fabricator leads to senior reps.

offers.title: Cutting-to-size / processing service as a standard offer
offers.for_whom: Dealers and fabricators needing exact sizes
offers.why: cutting_processing is a top-5 need (71 calls) and several won calls closed only after cutting/slitting was agreed.

offers.title: Priority/fast dispatch slot for urgent orders
offers.why: urgent_buyer behaviour (71) and fast_delivery need (124) are both high-frequency; urgency 'high' flagged in 104 calls.

offers.title: Consider a structured credit-period option for established dealers
offers.for_whom: Repeat/bulk dealers with consistent order history
offers.why: needs_credit (34), credit_period need (25) and credit_terms objection (31, only 16% win) show credit is a recurring blocker.

offers.title: Proactive stock/rate update subscription (WhatsApp/SMS)
offers.why: regular_updates is a top need (80 calls) and price_shopper is the most common behaviour (134 calls).

offers.title: Guaranteed test-certificate-with-every-dispatch bundle
offers.why: test_certificate need (49) and quality_doubt objection (58) are both significant; several stalled calls cite missing/delayed TCs.

offers.title: Dedicated off-cut/small-quantity and defective-stock lot sales
offers.why: small_quantity need (12) and min_quantity objection (15); won-call summaries show successful defective/off-cut sales.

loyalty.title: Formal repeat-customer recognition
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer accounts in CRM and give them a named contact/priority queue for calls and loading.
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer is a major behaviour (72 calls) but loyal_to_us is recorded in only 3 calls, showing loyalty is not being reinforced.

loyalty.title: Dedicated account manager for bulk buyers
loyalty.how: Assign one point-of-contact to bulk_buyer accounts for quotes, scheduling and after-sales queries.
loyalty.why: bulk_buyer (64) and consistent_supply need (54) suggest large accounts value continuity over one-off deals.

loyalty.title: Proactive WhatsApp update group for regular dealers
loyalty.how: Send scheduled stock/rate/dispatch updates instead of waiting for inbound calls.
loyalty.why: regular_updates is the 3rd highest need (80 calls).

loyalty.title: Referral recognition program
loyalty.how: Ask satisfied repeat customers for referrals and acknowledge/thank them when a referral converts.
loyalty.why: referral behaviour is currently rare (6 calls) despite 192 satisfied calls - untapped potential.

loyalty.title: Evaluate tiered trust-based credit/payment flexibility
loyalty.how: Define clear criteria (order history, volume) for offering extended terms without ad-hoc negotiation on every call.
loyalty.why: credit_terms objection has a low 16% win rate (31 calls) and needs_credit appears 34 times, often unresolved.

non_price_benefits.title: Quality assurance with test certificates
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt is a top objection (58 calls) and test_certificate a top-7 need (49 calls); TC issues recur throughout call summaries.

non_price_benefits.title: In-house cutting/processing capability
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need appears 71 times and features in many successfully closed calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable, fast delivery
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery is the 2nd highest need (124 calls) and delivery_time is a top-4 objection (48 calls).

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent stock across wide product range
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability is the top need (134) and top objection (116); product list spans plate, channel, angle, TMT, sheet, coil, beam etc.

non_price_benefits.title: Technical advice on grades/sizes
non_price_benefits.why: needs_technical_help (81 behaviour) and technical_advice (44 need) show many customers want guidance, not just a price.

non_price_benefits.title: Responsive, clear communication
non_price_benefits.why: slow_or_unclear_answer is the top rep gap (130 calls); fast clear answers directly correlate with the 74% win rate seen for satisfied calls.

top_questions.question: What is the current rate for this size/grade?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a clear, same-call answer or a firm time you will call back (e.g., 'by 2pm'); avoid open-ended delays since price_high is the top objection.

top_questions.question: Is this size/grade in stock right now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check and confirm in real time; if unavailable, immediately offer the closest alternative size, grade or off-cut instead of a flat no.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price / match a competitor's rate?
top_questions.answer_tip: Acknowledge the comparison, then highlight quality, test certificates, cutting service and delivery reliability before discussing any flexibility - don't just match blindly.

top_questions.question: When will the material/vehicle be delivered?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific time window, confirm it with dispatch before promising, and proactively update the customer if it will change.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation / proforma invoice?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send it within the same call or shortly after using a standard template; log and track that it was actually sent.

top_questions.question: Will you provide a test certificate with the material?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm TC is standard practice and will be sent with dispatch; proactively share it rather than waiting to be asked again.

top_questions.question: Can you offer credit / extended payment terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain current payment terms clearly and transparently; note that extended terms can be considered for established, regular accounts on a case-by-case basis.

top_questions.question: Why did the price increase from the last quote?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain that rates are market-linked and fluctuate, and offer to lock the current rate quickly if the customer wants to proceed.
